scenarios.title: Worker disconnects
scenarios.fault: The faulty worker drops its connection right after it receives its first partition, then reconnects like after a network failure.
scenarios.expectedDetection: The coordinator sees the connection close and marks the worker's attempts as lost.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Lost partitions are retried on connected workers; the task completes with the same result.

scenarios.title: Missed heartbeats
scenarios.fault: The faulty worker stops sending heartbeats 300 ms after it registers and answers its partitions only after 4 s.
scenarios.expectedDetection: Without heartbeats the worker becomes suspect, then lost when the heartbeat timeout (2 s in the lab) expires.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Its partitions are retried elsewhere; results it sends later are ignored.

scenarios.title: Corrupted results
scenarios.fault: Every result of the faulty worker is altered in transit, so its checksum no longer matches.
scenarios.expectedDetection: The coordinator verifies each partial result and rejects the corrupted ones.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Rejected partitions are retried on other workers; no corrupted value reaches the result.

scenarios.title: Duplicate results
scenarios.fault: The faulty worker sends every result twice.
scenarios.expectedDetection: The coordinator recognises the second copy of a result it already accepted.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Duplicates are ignored; no partition is counted twice.

scenarios.title: Kernel failures
scenarios.fault: Every attempt on the faulty worker reports a (retryable) kernel failure.
scenarios.expectedDetection: Each failure is reported by the worker and recorded with its reason.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Failed partitions are retried on workers that have not failed them, up to six attempts each.

scenarios.title: Hanging attempts
scenarios.fault: Every attempt on the faulty worker hangs: it never answers, not even to a cancellation.
scenarios.expectedDetection: Each attempt times out after 2 s (the lab's attempt timeout).
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Timed-out partitions are retried on other workers.

scenarios.title: Slow worker
scenarios.fault: The faulty worker computes five times slower than the others (a straggler).
scenarios.expectedDetection: Nothing fails; the slowdown shows as load imbalance and in the per-worker times.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: The task completes; how much the straggler delays it depends on the scheduling policy.

scenarios.title: Slow network link
scenarios.fault: Every message the faulty worker sends is delayed by 150 ms.
scenarios.expectedDetection: Nothing fails; the delay shows in the transfer time and the communication share.
scenarios.expectedRecovery: The task completes with the same result, later.

setup.workers: 1 faulty and 2 healthy, 2 slots each, in the application process
setup.heartbeat: every 200 ms; suspect after 800 ms; lost after 2 s
setup.coordinator: a separate coordinator on a loopback port, started for each run and stopped after
